target_flow: Provision a user-owned five-table Base and native views
Bind the React dashboard to that same Base without asking for a locator
Name one Agent and send one generated one-time pairing instruction
Agent reads the connection-test assignment and writes a real progress receipt

portable_layer.seed: one sanitized 连接测试 assignment

connection_layer.dashboard_reads: the authorized user's Base on every request
connection_layer.dashboard_writes: the same Base plus a receipt row
connection_layer.agent_transport: maxops-webhook-write/1 envelope from OPS Agent Connector v2
connection_layer.local_secret: Agent-specific bearer only; never the Feishu App Secret

security.oauth_state: AES-GCM sealed and cookie-bound with a ten-minute expiry
security.pairing: single-use, ten-minute code stored only as SHA-256
security.agent_scope: one workspace, one human name, one explicit test task
security.revocation: credential lookup fails immediately after revoked_at
security.workspace_revoke: revokes service and Agents while preserving the user-owned Base
security.public_origin: HTTPS custom origin required; github.io and workers.dev are rejected for production installation

coverage: OAuth redirect is Feishu-only and contains no secret
five tables, required fields, four native views and one connection-test task
Connector bootstrap reads the explicit connection-test task
progress writes to the Base and returns a receipt
same idempotency key and payload returns the existing receipt
Agent revoke denies the old bearer
desktop and 390x844 responsive browser fail-closed UI

public_installation.runtime_isolation: onboarding-only Worker plus onboarding metadata D1; private Agent APIs return 404
public_installation.required_app_type: Feishu Store App; non-public listing is sufficient for an install link
public_installation.required_runtime: confidential OAuth callback on an approved custom origin
public_installation.remaining_gate: The project owner must approve and create the non-public Feishu Store App
public_installation.reason_static_pages_is_insufficient: Feishu-created applications are confidential OAuth clients and require a client secret during token exchange

no_hosting_fallback.flow: copy the Base template, create a tenant self-built app, keep its secret locally, and run feishu_base_direct

verified_private_baseline: Connector read, claim, acknowledgement, progress, question, artifact, finish and receipt
